content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2 && cat > /tmp/test_callout.c << 'EOF'
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "pcre2.h"
int main() {
    int errcode;
    PCRE2_SIZE erroffset;

    // Try to compile with auto_callout
    pcre2_code *re = pcre2_compile(
        (PCRE2_SPTR)"a", 1,
        PCRE2_AUTO_CALLOUT | PCRE2_NEVER_BACKSLASH_C,
        &errcode, &erroffset, NULL);

    if (re == NULL) {
        printf("Compile failed\n");
        return 1;
    }

    printf("Compile succeeded\n");

    pcre2_match_data *md = pcre2_match_data_create_from_pattern(re, NULL);
    int rc = pcre2_match(re, (PCRE2_SPTR)"a", 1, 0, 0, md, NULL);
    printf("Match returned %d\n", rc);

    pcre2_match_data_free(md);
    pcre2_code_free(re);
    return 0;
}
EOF
